name: Shadow boxing

phases.name: jab
phases.cue: Jab: snap your left fist straight out

phases.name: jab back
phases.cue: Bring it straight back to your chin

phases.name: cross
phases.cue: Cross: turn your hips and drive your right fist out

formTips: Keep your hands up by your chin between punches
Turn your hips and shoulders into the cross
Punch straight out and straight back
Keep your knees soft and your weight on the balls of your feet
commonMistakes: Dropping the other hand while punching
Locking the elbow hard at the end of a punch
